name: Modern Energy
old_description: We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all of our past clients for your trust and support over the years. Due to the lasting impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic, Modern Energy made the difficult decision to discontinue operations in 2021. While we are no longer able to offer our services to past or new clients, we are deeply proud of the work we accomplished together and sincerely thank you for being a part of our journey. It has been a privilege to serve you.
about:
Modern Energy was a solar panel installation company based in Dublin, Ohio. The company ceased operations in 2021, citing the lasting impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic as the reason for its closure. No founding year or ownership details were publicly disclosed.

The firm specialized in the design and installation of photovoltaic systems for residential and commercial properties. As a service-oriented installer, Modern Energy did not manufacture its own equipment but sourced panels, inverters, and mounting hardware from third-party suppliers. Project scale ranged from small rooftop arrays to larger commercial installations, though specific volume metrics were not published.

Modern Energy served homeowners, businesses, and property developers in the central Ohio region seeking renewable energy solutions. Its customer base included individuals looking to reduce electricity costs and organizations pursuing sustainability goals. The company did not disclose specific industry verticals beyond general solar adoption.

The company did not publicly articulate a specific founding mission or competitive differentiation beyond its service offering. Its closure announcement expressed gratitude to past clients and pride in the work accomplished during its operational years.
